Jin Taekyung.alt: Jin Taekyung is a handsome young man of about twenty with a tall, well-proportioned build. He has bold, well-defined features that look both boyish and worldly-young, and clear, deep black eyes.

Jin Taekyung is a handsome young man of about twenty with a tall, well-proportioned build, bold well-defined features that look both boyish and worldly-young, and clear, deep black eyes. After completing the Bone Transformation, his palms have skin as hard as iron and his nails are sharp.

Jeok Cheongang.alt: Jeok Cheongang is a very old, frail-looking man who seems close to death, with white eyebrows and a deeply wrinkled, naturally fierce face. He has clear, transparent eyes and a small, slight frame in shabby, worn clothes.

Jeok Cheongang, after returning to youth through enlightenment, is a middle-aged man with red hair, red eyebrows and a dark-red chin beard, with the old-age frailty gone. His face is still fierce, his eyes clear and transparent, and his frame small and slight; red flame is his motif.

Jeok Cheongang has shaved his head to a bald, sun-glinting scalp and wears a worn monk's robe. He looks markedly younger, a rejuvenated middle-aged man with red eyebrows and a dark-red chin beard, a fierce face, small slight frame, and clear eyes that still carry the weight of years.

Jeok Cheongang has short red hair growing back in on his previously shaved head. He is a rejuvenated, youthful-bodied man with red eyebrows and a dark-red chin beard, a fierce face, and a small slight frame; his old, worn eyes belie the young body.

Hyuk Mujin.alt: Hyuk Mujin is a lean, agile young man standing 180 cm tall, with a pale, almost Caucasian-white complexion and an ugly face with an insolent, sharp-eyed look. He has distinctive thick caterpillar-like eyebrows and wears the navy martial robe of the Taewon Jin family.

Cheongpung.alt: Cheongpung is a young man, just past twenty, with an average, moderate build and a perfect physique and bone structure. He has a friendly, affable face with clear, bright eyes.

Team Leader Choi.alt: Team Leader Choi is a man in his 20s with a slender build that hides great muscle strength. He has strikingly handsome, celebrity-level looks. He wears a thin tailored suit over a luxury designer shirt, a polished, photo-shoot style.

Jin Wikyung.alt: Jin Wikyung is a man of apparent age thirty-five, a towering giant with a bulky, bear-like physique, very broad massive shoulders and prominent muscles showing through his clothing. His eyes look dim, as if about to go out. He carries the Taewon Jin family's heirloom sword and wears martial robes embroidered with a silver flying dragon, with an imposing, dignified bearing.

Taishan.alt: Taishan is a male figure with a huge, bulky, mountain-like giant frame, roughly 2.7 m tall. He has very large, round, bulging eyes, as big as a calf's.

Human Butcher.alt: Human Butcher, a male butcher who wields a sword called Chammageom.

Skeleton King.alt: Skeleton King is a male figure with a larger, sturdier body with a faint golden hue, shaped to a tailored, idealized build. He has a strikingly handsome, pretty-boy human-looking face, blond (golden) hair and golden eyes. An unknown silver crown-like mark is engraved on his forehead, his hands look almost human, and he wears a radiant golden crown.
Skeleton King is reduced to only a bare skull, with no body. The skull has no pupils, and blue ghost-fire flickers in the eye sockets. An unknown silver crown-like mark is engraved on the forehead.

Magic Johnson.alt: Magic Johnson is a huge, bulky, large-framed man with dark black skin and clear, transparent-looking eyes. He carries a large, handsome staff.
